title: "About"
description: "Data science leader in healthcare; background, how I work, and what I do outside the job."
---

I'm a data science leader working across statistics, machine learning, healthcare strategy, and operations. I lead a team of four data scientists and stay hands-on as a player-coach: I set direction, mentor the team, and turn technically demanding work into clear, useful decisions.

Most of my experience is in healthcare, where I've worked on forecasting, causal inference, classification, and decision support. The methods aren't specific to healthcare. I'm extending them into modern AI and machine learning, and the projects on this site are where that shows up.

## How I work

- **Insight that influences decisions.** Creative statistical approaches, automated reporting, and interactive data stories aimed at strategic problem solving.
- **Clear commitments.** Defined deliverables and timelines, with frequent, plain-language communication.
- **Teaching as part of the job.** I mentor data scientists at work and teach statistics and data analysis at the university level.

## Beyond work

Outside my day job I point the same skills at things I'm personally curious about: sports (March Madness brackets, in-game decisions), trivia (I'm building a study system for a Jeopardy! audition), personal finance and real estate, and — through family in the industry — agriculture. Some of that shows up here as projects; most of it is just how I spend my curiosity.
